attachments.name: 21-1199 Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement – Nor-Cal Moving Services –Fremont High School Library Relocation Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $26,501 and six months for Nor-Cal Moving's Fremont High library relocation

money.evidence: in an additional amount of  $26,501.20

enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $26,501.20 to the district's agreement with Nor-Cal Moving Services for continued moving work on the Fremont High School library relocation. The maximum rises from $29,988.00 to $56,489.20, and the term is extended by 180 calendar days to January 31, 2022. The work is paid from Measure J bond funds.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by President Gonzales, seconded by Director Williams, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement between the District and Nor-Cal Moving Services, Hayward, CA, for the latter to provide continued moving services, for the Fremont High School Library Relocation Project, in an additional amount of  $26,501.20, increasing Agreement not to exceed amount from $29,988.00 to $56,489.20, and extending the term of the Agreement from February 25, 2021 to August 4, 2021 to January 31, 2022 (an additional 180 calendar days), and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Consultant. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
